subject: Invoice shows charges despite promo credits — can you confirm?
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@acme.cloud>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Unexpected invoice — trial tokens charged + VAT?

Hi Diego,

We just received invoice #3742 for our account and it looks like several line items that should have been covered by the PLG trial credits were billed and VAT was applied. I attached the invoice (invoice_3742.pdf).

We signed up last week and saw the free credits in the console, so I don't understand why we're being charged. Can you confirm:
- Were trial credits applied to usage for the period ending 2026-08-10?
- Why is VAT appearing on the invoice even though we provided our EU VAT number at signup?

This is a blocker for our procurement team — they want confirmation that the charges will be reversed or credited before we finalize the purchase order. Please advise ASAP.

Thanks,
Emma Li
Procurement Manager
Acme Cloud
emma@acme.cloud

Attachments: invoice_3742.pdf
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@acme.cloud>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected invoice — trial tokens charged + VAT?

Emma — thanks for flagging, and sorry for the confusion. I saw the invoice you attached. I'm looping in Marissa from Billing and Jordan on the account so we can get a definitive answer and, if needed, correct or credit the invoice.

Quick context for you: most PLG trial credits are applied at invoice time and should offset usage. There is an edge case where short billing-cycle timing or a delayed promo application can cause a provisional invoice to list charges and tax; we then apply adjustments once promos/VAT are validated.

Can you confirm Acme's VAT number (EU VAT ID) and the account ID you see in the Redwood console? That will help Marissa diagnose the invoice routing.

I will follow up within the next business day.

—Diego
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-13T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected invoice — trial tokens charged + VAT? (invoice #3742)

Hi Emma (and team),

Thanks for the note and the invoice — I pulled up invoice #3742 and the account record. Summary of what I see and next steps:

1) Promo credit application
- The promotional trial credits for Acme Cloud were issued on 2026-08-05 and are visible in the console. However, the credits were assigned after some usage had already been ingested into the billing pipeline for the snapshot used to generate invoice #3742. That caused the invoice to show provisional token charges.

2) VAT handling
- We did not find a validated EU VAT ID on file at the moment the invoice was generated. For EU VAT reverse-charge exemption we need the validated VAT ID on the account prior to invoice finalization. If you can provide the VAT number, we can validate it against VIES and (if valid) re-issue the invoice without VAT.

3) Proposed remedy
- If Acme confirms the VAT number and we validate it, we will:
  * Post a one-time invoice adjustment to remove the VAT portion and apply the promo credits to the billed usage.
  * Issue a credit memo that offsets invoice #3742.
  * Provide a corrected invoice and credit memo PDF within 3 business days of confirmation.

4) Timeline and required items
- Please reply with: Acme Cloud account ID (or the exact email used to register), and the EU VAT number to validate.
- Once validated, we will apply the adjustment and confirm by email. If needed we can also have Jordan help expedite procurement communications.

I attached a draft adjustment showing the expected credit (adjustment-draft.pdf) and our promo policy for reference (promo-policy.pdf).

Apologies for the hassle — we want this cleaned up quickly.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: adjustment-draft.pdf, promo-policy.pdf
